#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Root grants exclusive timing before invoking this script; do not run as a background task yourself.
base=tmp/optimization-wave-20261013/scheduler-needs-bench
before=tmp/optimization-wave-20261013/scheduler-needs-before/node_modules/scheduler-needs-baseline/src
candidate=$base/node_modules/candidate/src
out=$base/timing.ndjson
[[ ! -e "$out" ]] || { echo "refusing to overwrite timing evidence" >&2; exit 1; }
for comparison in implementation adoption; do
  if [[ "$comparison" == implementation ]]; then
    pairs=("static-off:static-off" "legacy-custom-off:legacy-custom-off" "legacy-terminal-none:legacy-terminal-none" "legacy-terminal-execution:legacy-terminal-execution" "legacy-terminal-raw:legacy-terminal-raw" "diagnostics-on:diagnostics-on")
  else
    pairs=("legacy-custom-off:declared-custom-off" "legacy-terminal-none:terminal-none" "legacy-terminal-execution:terminal-execution" "legacy-terminal-raw:terminal-raw")
  fi
  for n in 8 128; do
    for pair in "${pairs[@]}"; do
      for round in 1 2; do
        lanes=(A B B A)
        [[ "$round" == 1 ]] || lanes=(B A A B)
        for lane in "${lanes[@]}"; do
          root=$candidate; mode=${pair#*:}
          if [[ "$lane" == A ]]; then mode=${pair%:*}; [[ "$comparison" != implementation ]] || root=$before; fi
          line=$(mise exec -- bun "$base/measure.ts" "$root" "$mode" "$n" 12)
          printf "{\"comparison\":\"%s\",\"pair\":\"%s\",\"round\":%s,\"lane\":\"%s\",\"sample\":%s}\n" "$comparison" "$pair" "$round" "$lane" "$line" >> "$out"
        done
      done
    done
  done
 done
